import random

seed = int(input())
rng = random.Random(seed)
n = rng.randint(2, 9)
m = rng.randint(1, 14)
print(n, m)
for _ in range(m):
    u = rng.randint(1, n)
    v = rng.randint(1, n - 1)
    if v >= u:
        v += 1
    print(u, v, rng.randint(1, 20))
